name: v0.3.66 — GuacMoney = the money Guac-AI saved you
releaseNotes:
• GuacMoney now means real savings — the money our Guac-AI saved you: purchases you rated “not worth it” (so you won't re-buy them) + refunds you recovered, dollar for dollar.
• GuacMoney screen shows where it came from (not-worth-it vs refunds) and how to grow it (rate your purchases in Worth It?).
• 1,000 GuacMoney = $1.
